subject: Vertica Digital pilot — request for temporary invoice-only onboarding
messages:

Date: 2027-03-14T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot onboarding — billing flexibility request (Vertica Digital)

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Vertica Digital engineering team is excited to move forward with a 60-day pilot. One operational snag: our procurement requires an initial invoice-only arrangement for first-month pilots (we can't provide a PO up front for pilots run through our corporate trial process).

Can Redwood accept invoices without a PO for a short pilot (two invoices max, total not to exceed $15,000)? If needed, we can provide the W-9, a simple SOW, and a billing contact for remittance.

We want to keep things simple and get the model running in our environment by next week. If there are conditional controls Redwood needs (e.g., spend cap, invoicing cadence, or proof-of-delivery), happy to comply.

Attaching a copy of our standard vendor form and draft SOW (see attachment stubs below).

Attachments: vertica_vendor_info_form.pdf (stub), draft_sow_vertica.docx (stub)

Best,
Paul Harris

Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — billing flexibility request (Vertica Digital)

Marissa / Laura — looping you both in. Vertica (external) is asking for an invoice-only onboarding for an initial 60-day pilot; total expected spend under $15k. They say they cannot issue a PO for pilots, but can provide W-9 and an SOW.

Quick asks:
- Laura, can finance sign off on a temporary invoice-only path for a pilot subject to controls (spend cap + evidence)?
- Marissa, please capture this in HubSpot and confirm whether Sales is comfortable with the $15k cap and two-invoice cadence.

My suggested conditional approval (tentative):
- Temporary invoice-only allowance for up to 60 days, not to exceed $15,000 total;
- Maximum single invoice $7,500;
- Required documents before first invoice: W-9, signed SOW, vendor remit info;
- Finance to open a PO-exception record and monitor invoices;
- Exception auto-reverts after pilot unless formal PO arrangement agreed.

I attached the draft SOW Vertica sent (attachment stub). If you need a formal PO exception form filled out, let me know and I can start the paperwork.

Thanks — I want to avoid blocking onboarding next week.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Manager, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — billing flexibility request (Vertica Digital)

Irene / Marissa,

We can approve a short-term invoice-only path for pilots on a case-by-case basis. Required items before any invoice is paid:

1) Completed vendor W-9 (or equivalent tax form) — verifiable name and remit address.
2) Signed SOW that shows scope and acceptance criteria (simple is fine).
3) Vendor onboarding questionnaire or basic AML check (finance will confirm name match).
4) Completed PO exception form recorded in our procurement system (see filename stub).

Controls we will enforce:
- Pilot cap: $15,000 total over 60 days;
- Per-invoice limit: $7,500;
- Invoices must reference the HubSpot deal id (HS-45821-VD) and include the signed SOW reference;
- Payments processed on standard net-30 after invoice approval;
- Exception expires automatically at end of pilot and will not set precedent without procurement sign-off.

Please collect the W-9 and signed SOW from Vertica and upload to the vendor intake folder. I attached the PO exception form we use internally (po_exception_form.pdf stub) — please fill the top section and I will route for sign-off.

Once I receive the documents I can mark the exception approved and tell you the maximum allowable amount in the system.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Paul Harris <paul.harris@veridianlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — billing flexibility request (Vertica Digital)

Paul — good news. Finance has agreed to a temporary invoice-only onboarding under the conditions below. We can proceed once you provide the items Laura requested.

Summary of approved temporary terms:
- 60-day pilot window starting on the date of first invoice;
- Total pilot cap: $15,000;
- Per-invoice maximum: $7,500;
- Required before first invoice: vendor W-9, signed SOW, remit/billing contact;
- Please reference HubSpot deal HS-45821-VD on invoices and attach the signed SOW as supporting docs when you submit invoices.
- Exception will auto-expire at end of 60-day pilot unless we agree on standard PO terms.

Action items for Vertica:
1) Reply to this thread with W-9 and signed SOW (or DocuSign link).
2) Confirm billing contact and remit address.
3) Confirm expected invoice dates (so finance can expect them).

Laura will create the PO-exception record once we upload the W-9 and SOW — we should be able to complete internal approvals within 24 hours of receiving clean docs.

If you want to speed this along, send the W-9 and SOW link now and I will ping finance directly.

Best,
Irene Choi
Manager, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
